title: Zalce jailed five days by the Mexican Navy
summary: Jose Zalce tells of Zalce jailed five days by the Mexican Navy, about 2020s at Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I spent around 5 days in jail because they they said I I was a liar and I was putting in risk the honorability of of the whole system of the Navy.

plain: A man named Jose Zalce, talking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about small three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru, says that sometime in the 2020s in Mexico he spent around five days in jail. According to Zalce, the Mexican Navy called him a liar and said he was putting the honour of the whole Navy at risk. He tells it as a sign of how much trouble his claims about the bodies have brought him.
